high_level_description: The image depicts a man dressed in traditional Middle Eastern attire. He is wearing a white dishdasha with gold embroidery on the shoulders and chest, which is a common garment for formal occasions in the region. Over his head, he has a black and white keffiyeh, a traditional headscarf that is often worn by men in the Middle East. The man appears to be engaged in an activity involving a red object, possibly a book or a document, as he holds it with both hands. His expression is serious, suggesting that he might be focused on reading or examining the contents of the object.
